```c
void Blowfish_encipher(blf_ctx *c, unsigned long *x1, unsigned long *xr)
{
unsigned long X1;
unsigned long XR;
unsigned long temp;
short
    i;

X1 = *x1;
XR = *xr;

for (i = 0; i < N; ++i++) {
    X1 = X1 ^ c->P[i];
    XR = F(c,X1) ^ XR;

    temp = X1;
    X1 = XR;
    XR = temp;
}

temp = X1;
X1 = XR;
XR = temp;

XR = XR ^ c->P[N];
X1 = X1 ^ c->P[N + 1];

*x1 = X1;
*xr = XR;
}
```
